question: Who does not become accomplished after entering?
premises: the cremation ground is filled with countless consciousness
it is terrifying consciousness and support of all deities
one who enters there becomes accomplished
inference: no one entering there fails to become accomplished
uncertainties: rhetorical force of ko na siddhyati
plain_english: In the cremation ground filled with countless consciousness, terrifying consciousness, support of all deities, who entering does not become accomplished?
